title: Cu CMP slurry delivery degradation
symptom: Slurry flow decline, removal-rate loss, endpoint extension, Cu residue, leakage short
root_cause: Slurry delivery degradation reduced Cu CMP removal rate
solution: Inspect slurry pump, replace slurry filter, calibrate flow controller, run qualification wafers

title: Isolated single-Wafer scratch investigation
symptom: One Wafer has an isolated scratch while adjacent Wafers and equipment FDC are normal
root_cause: Transient particle or handling event; exact source was not confirmed
solution: Inspect handling path, review particle monitors, inspect carrier, monitor subsequent Lots

title: ILD deposition chamber rate excursion
symptom: Even Wafers have low pre-CMP and post-CMP thickness with normal CMP FDC
solution: Hold CVD chamber, verify deposition rate, calibrate gas delivery, run thickness qualification
